BeepBox 4.2.2
Upstream: https://github.com/johnnesky/beepbox
Release: https://github.com/johnnesky/beepbox/releases/download/v4.2.2/BeepBox_4_2_2.zip
SHA-256: 884e5acb4007535b47b124f66f9a72b339a8df80a625ba6ae952873c166e81de
Official release bundle (MIT; the release ZIP ships no licence file, so the repo LICENSE.md at tag v4.2.2 is pinned by SHA-256 and copied here). WebPC removes the Google Fonts stylesheet (the UI falls back to system sans-serif), removes the service-worker registration (upstream requests scope "/" and would precache a third-party CDN, shadowing the whole site if it could install), prunes the files nothing loads (unminified editor, minified synth, beepbox_offline.html, index_debug.html, source maps, macOS .DS_Store — the About link to beepbox_offline.html 404s by design), keeps player/ (the "View in Song Player" menu item and copied HTML embeds point at it at runtime) with its Google Fonts link stripped, and injects webpc-audio-guard.js before the app scripts so the WebPC wrapper can pause and suspend audio when its window closes. The song stays in the URL hash; the WebPC wrapper mirrors it to localStorage. Share-menu shortener links (tinyurl, is.gd, …) and the PayPal donation form only send data when the user explicitly submits them. See docs/webpc/static-apps.md.
